test_cases.name: Audit log credential data minimization
test_cases.enforcement: Strict redaction of secrets in security event records

test_cases.name: Error sanitization (zero stack traces leaked)
test_cases.enforcement: Sanitized error JSON payloads; no tracebacks

test_cases.name: Audit logging for licensing and device events
test_cases.enforcement: Immutable audit events logged for activation and query

test_cases.name: Cross-tenant denial security event generation
test_cases.enforcement: DENIED audit event generated on IDOR probe

test_cases.name: Cryptographic hash chain integrity verification
test_cases.enforcement: Hash chain verified valid: H_i = SHA-256(H_{i-1} || E_i)

test_cases.name: Security incident alerting
test_cases.enforcement: Threat alerts listed on admin monitoring API

test_cases.name: Disaster recovery non-resurrection verification
test_cases.enforcement: Revoked licenses cannot resurrect after state reloads
